en: Beneath the waves, where sunbeams sway, / a city grows by night and day. / No bricks, no roads, no busy town, / just coral towers, gold and brown.
Each tower is built by creatures small, / so tiny you can hardly see them at all. / They look like stone or branching trees, / yet they are animals of the seas.
The parrotfish goes crunch, crunch, crunch, / it scrapes the coral for its lunch. / The clownfish hides in waving arms / that keep it safe from passing harms.
A turtle glides with flippers wide, / a moray peeps from where it hides. / And every crack and every cave / is someone's home beneath the wave.
So when you swim, look with your eyes, / and leave the coral where it lies. / Don't touch, don't take, don't drop a thing, / and let the reef keep whispering.
id: Di bawah ombak, cahaya menari, / ada kota tumbuh setiap hari. / Tak ada bata, tak ada jalan, / hanya menara karang berjajaran.
Menara dibangun hewan yang mungil, / satu per satu, sabar dan terampil. / Ia mirip batu, mirip pohon bercabang, / padahal ia hewan yang hidup dan berkembang.
Ikan kakatua menggigit, kres-kres-kres, / mengerik makan siangnya di karang yang keras. / Ikan badut sembunyi di lengan bergoyang, / di anemon itu ia aman dan tenang.
Penyu meluncur dengan sirip lebar, / belut laut mengintip dari lubang yang samar. / Setiap celah dan setiap gua / adalah rumah bagi penghuni di sana.
Saat berenang, pakailah matamu, / biarkan karang di tempatnya selalu. / Jangan sentuh, jangan ambil, jangan buang sampah, / biar terumbu terus berbisik dengan ramah.

objectives.en: Reads a rhyming poem aloud with rhythm and finds the rhyming pairs.
objectives.id: Membaca puisi berima dengan irama dan menemukan pasangan kata berima.

objectives.en: Explains what the poet compares the reef to and what message the poem gives.
objectives.id: Menjelaskan apa yang dibandingkan penyair dengan terumbu dan pesan apa yang disampaikan puisi.

meaning.en: a group of lines in a poem, like a paragraph in a story

meaning.en: a soft sea animal with many waving arms
meaning.id: hewan laut lunak dengan banyak lengan yang bergoyang

meaning.en: words that end with the same sound, like day and sway
meaning.id: kata-kata yang berakhiran bunyi sama, seperti menari dan hari

a real town with roads
a sunken ship

stones
trees

people build houses under the sea

collect coral to take home

connection.en: Corals are animals, and reefs give food and shelter to many sea creatures.
connection.id: Karang adalah hewan, dan terumbu memberi makanan serta tempat berlindung bagi banyak makhluk laut.

connection.en: Not touching coral and not leaving rubbish helps reefs stay healthy.
connection.id: Tidak menyentuh karang dan tidak meninggalkan sampah membantu terumbu tetap sehat.

connection.en: Poets use comparisons, sound words and rhyme to paint a picture.
connection.id: Penyair memakai perbandingan, kata bunyi, dan rima untuk melukis gambaran.

discussionPrompts.en: Which line made the clearest picture in your mind? Why?
discussionPrompts.id: Baris mana yang membuat gambaran paling jelas di pikiranmu? Mengapa?

discussionPrompts.en: Why do you think the poet ends with the reef "whispering"?
discussionPrompts.id: Menurutmu mengapa penyair menutup puisi dengan terumbu yang "berbisik"?

offlineActivity.en: Write one new four-line stanza for the poem about another reef animal, such as a sea star, an octopus or a seahorse. Make lines 1 and 2 rhyme, and lines 3 and 4 rhyme. Read the whole poem aloud with your stanza added, tapping the beat.
offlineActivity.id: Tulis satu bait baru berisi empat baris untuk puisi ini tentang hewan terumbu lain, misalnya bintang laut, gurita, atau kuda laut. Buat baris 1 dan 2 berima, serta baris 3 dan 4 berima. Bacakan seluruh puisi dengan baitmu, sambil mengetuk iramanya.

factChecks.claim: Corals are animals that build reefs.
Parrotfish scrape and bite coral surfaces when they feed, making a crunching sound.
Clownfish shelter among the tentacles of sea anemones.
Moray eels live in holes and crevices in reefs.
